description: Defines static class GrainTypePrefix containing constants and extension methods for identifying and working with different grain type prefixes in Orleans.

classes.name: GrainTypePrefix
classes.description: Contains prefix strings and helper methods for identifying grain types, such as system, client, legacy, and grain service types.

methods.name: IsClient
methods.description: Checks if a GrainType or GrainId represents a client based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsSystemTarget
methods.description: Checks if a GrainType or GrainId represents a system target based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsLegacyGrain
methods.description: Checks if a GrainType has the legacy grain prefix.

methods.name: IsGrainService
methods.description: Checks if a GrainType has the grain service prefix.
